manifest.name: dsh-combo
manifest.description: PowerMode-style real-time streaming token and tool-call combo feedback for DeepSeek Harness, featuring 5 distinct presets, 6 synthesized audio themes, and a live HUD simulator.

bundle.text:
# dsh-combo — DSH bundle patch (mount declaration).
#
# The bundle inserts one row; DSH composes it into the desktop/web profile.
# Core options live on this row's `config`. Other settings fall back to schema
# defaults (per DSH packaging guidelines) and can be tuned here or via the UI.
#
# Install (from a workspace checkout):
#   dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:/abs/path/to/dsh-combo
- insert:
    - id: dsh-combo
      name: 'dsh-combo'
      config:
        enabled: true
        # hybrid | tokens | tools
        comboMode: hybrid
        # particles | fireworks | slash | aura | glitch
        preset: particles
        # classic | cyberpunk | sunset | matrix | frost
        colorTheme: classic
        # top-right | top-left | bottom-right | bottom-left
        position: top-right
        # sound is opt-in: false by default
        sound: false
        # blip | keyboard | bubble | arcade | laser | melodic
        soundTheme: blip
        soundVolume: 0.35
        # Countdown refills on thoughts and tool calls (ms)
        timerMs: 10000
        # 0 = purely turn-based. >0 breaks a run after idle gap (ms)
        expireMs: 0

简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

dsh-combo 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的轻量级连击反馈插件，为 DSH Web 界面和 DSH Desktop 桌面端带来 PowerMode 风格的打字暴击与工具调用连击体验。支持实时 Token 连击、5 大视觉动效预设、5 款调色板主题、6 种 Web Audio 合成音色以及内置交互模拟器。

- **实时流式 Token 暴击**：监听 `assistant/live-chunk` 流式输出，实时打字暴击爽感拉满！同时兼容 Host 提供的 `dshCombo` 会话投影与持久化工具调用（支持 `hybrid` 混合、`tokens` 纯打字、`tools` 经典工具回合三种模式）。
- **倒计时进度条与灵活节拍**：默认按 turn 计数；支持通过 `expireMs` 启用空闲倒计时（配有一键预设 `[ ∞ 无限 | 5秒 | 10秒 | 30秒 | 60秒 ]`）；支持通过 `tokensPerCombo` 自定义每次连击所需 token 比例。
- **5 大视觉动效预设 & 5 套调色板**：支持 `particles`（晶莹粒子）、`fireworks`（绚烂烟花）、`slash`（光刃斩击）、`aura`（超赛气焰）、`glitch`（赛博故障）五大动效力学，搭配 `classic`、`cyberpunk`、`sunset`、`matrix`、`frost` 调色板，支持多段位跃升至 500+。
- **6 款纯 Web Audio 合成打击音效**：纯本地声学合成（`blip`、`keyboard`、`bubble`、`arcade`、`laser`、`melodic`），零外部音频文件依赖。
- **沉浸式高阶增强**：支持屏幕边缘能量晕影（Screen Vignette）、连击里程碑成就称号浮现、高吞吐批量暴击角标（CRIT!）以及战绩结算卡。
- **独立配置页与内嵌交互模拟器**：在侧栏**插件 → dsh-combo**拥有专属配置中心，内置交互式迷你 HUD 连击模拟器与实时音效试听；HUD 悬浮窗亦带有一键快捷面板。
- **轻量纯净与跨端运行**：纯客户端呈现，不修改模型上下文，不发起第三方网络请求，Pin 状态跨会话本地持久化。

通过官方 `dsh plugin` CLI 命令安装。Web 和 Desktop 使用不同 profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:QuentinCrane/dsh-combo

dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:QuentinCrane/dsh-combo
```

> **Desktop 提示**：首次使用 DSH Desktop 时，先启动一次应用以初始化 profile，退出后运行 Desktop 附带的 `dsh` 命令（若终端中未识别，可在应用的 **Manage dsh Command** 中启用）。详见 [官方 Desktop 指南](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/desktop/README.md#bundled-command-runtime)。

如需安装本地开发源码目录，传入包含 `package.json` 的绝对路径：sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-combo
```

无需手动编辑配置文件，插件提供了完善的可视化配置体验：

1. **界面独立配置页（推荐）**：打开侧栏 **插件** → 选中 `dsh-combo` → **配置**。保存直接写入 profile 配置，**即时生效，无需重启或刷新页面**。
2. **HUD 悬浮窗齿轮面板**：点击连击悬浮窗旁的齿轮（⚙️）可在当前浏览器快速调优并一键切换预设。
3. **Profile 补丁文件 (`cordis.patch.yml`)**：在 profile 中声明全局缺省配置。

```yaml
- id: dsh-combo
  config:
    enabled: true
    comboMode: hybrid        # hybrid (混合) | tokens (打字) | tools (工具)

👉 **查看完整的 38 项配置参数字典、默认值及取值范围，请参阅 [配置参考指南](docs/configuration.zh-CN.md) ([English](docs/configuration.md))。**

[简体中文](README.md) | English

A lightweight DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin providing PowerMode-style combo feedback for streaming text and tool calls in DSH Web and DSH Desktop. Features real-time token combos, 5 dynamic visual presets, 5 color themes, 6 synthesized Web Audio styles, and a live HUD simulator.

- **Real-Time Streaming Token Hits**: Listens to streaming chunks (`assistant/live-chunk`) to compute token-level combos as the model types, delivering immediate visual and audio hits! Supports `hybrid` (tokens + tools), `tokens`, and `tools` modes.
- **Rhythm & Countdown Bar**: Turn-based by default. Set `expireMs` for an idle timeout bar with quick presets (`[ ∞ Infinite | 5s | 10s | 30s | 60s ]`). Tune `tokensPerCombo` for custom strike ratios.
- **5 Visual Presets & 5 Color Themes**: Choose from `particles`, `fireworks`, `slash`, `aura`, and `glitch` presets, paired with `classic`, `cyberpunk`, `sunset`, `matrix`, or `frost` dynamic themes scaling up to 500+ combos.
- **6 Synthesized Web Audio Sound Themes**: Pure Web Audio synthesis (`blip`, `keyboard`, `bubble`, `arcade`, `laser`, `melodic`) with zero external sound files.
- **Immersion Enhancements**: Optional full-screen ambient energy vignette, milestone achievement badges, critical hit (`CRIT!`) popups, and streak recap cards.
- **Interactive Configuration Page & Mini Simulator**: Dedicated configuration page under **Plugins → dsh-combo** with a live interactive HUD mini-simulator and sound auditioning, plus an on-HUD qui

Install using the official DSH CLI. Web and Desktop have separate profiles:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:QuentinCrane/dsh-combo

dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:QuentinCrane/dsh-combo
```

> **Desktop Note**: Launch DSH Desktop once to initialize its profile, fully quit it, and run Desktop's bundled `dsh` CLI (enable it via **Manage dsh Command** in the app if not on your PATH). See the [Desktop guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/desktop/README.md#bundled-command-runtime).

To install from a local repository checkout:sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-combo
```
`dsh-combo` is designed to be configured effortlessly without manual file editing:

1. **In-App Configuration Page (Recommended)**: Go to **Plugins** in the sidebar → select `dsh-combo` → **配置**. Changes save directly to your profile and apply live without page reloads or restarts.
2. **HUD Quick-Tune Popover**: Click the gear (⚙️) on the combo counter for instant per-browser tuning, theme previewing, and 1-click preset switching.
3. **Profile Patch (`cordis.patch.yml`)**: Declare custom defaults in your profile's patch file.

```yaml
- id: dsh-combo
  config:
    enabled: true
    comboMode: hybrid        # hybrid | tokens | tools

👉 **For the complete 38-property schema, defaults, and ranges, see the [Configuration Reference](docs/configuration.md) ([中文](docs/configuration.zh-CN.md)).**
